meta.source: Figma: Delivery App UI Kit (Community), file 3wVcpGe9A3FwruPJ6IkYpx, pages Screens and Components

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Figma style Background. Page and screen background, tab bar.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Figma style White. Cards, search field, text fields, unselected chips and the secondary (outline) button.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Figma style Text Primary. Titles, item names, prices, field text and outline icons. 14.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Figma style Text Secondary. Item counts, units (€ / kg), placeholders, field labels, unselected chips and inactive tab icons. 3.3:1 on white: fine at 24px+ or for icons, below 4.5:1 for small text (kept as in the source).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Figma style Border. 1px card, search-field, text-field and outline-button borders; the tab bar's top divider.

tokens.name: primary-button
tokens.usage: Figma style Primary Button. Primary and icon buttons (Add to cart). White labels on it are 2.1:1, as in the source; keep labels bold, uppercase and 15px+.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selected chip text and check icon; the selected tab icon. Use for selection, never for primary actions.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Figma style Selected BG Violet. Selected chip background, with accent text on it (5.0:1). The Components page's chip uses #D6B6FF; the screens use this style.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Figma style Green. Decorative food illustrations, such as the broccoli at the top right of the Vegetables screen. Not for text, actions or selection.

tokens.name: media-placeholder
tokens.usage: Behind product and category photos while they load.

families.display: "SF Pro Display", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Roboto, sans-serif
families.sans: "SF Pro Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Roboto, sans-serif

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips and buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Text inset inside category cards; chip and field side padding (15–16px in Figma).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and the gap between cards in the category grid.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between the search field and the content below it.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, product photos and text fields.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Search field (27px in Figma) and chips (17px in Figma): fully rounded ends.
